video_title: 76ers' V. J. Edgecombe talks classic jerseys, his NBA career so far & playing with LeBron 🏀🤩

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on why he chose the number 77
quotes.excerpt: I was a seven guy, so I wore seven my whole life. But Kalo Kalarie has seven.
quotes.quote: I initially wanted a seven. I am a seven guy, so I wore seven my whole life, all through high school. But Kalo Kalarie has seven. And he is a legend, so I was not even going to bother to ask or anything like that. So I was like, I will just double the number.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on Buddy Hield as a mentor
quotes.excerpt: Buddy Hield is someone I look up to growing up. He was born and raised there.
quotes.quote: Buddy Hield is someone I look up to growing up. Obviously, from my time, the only NBA player. Obviously, he was born and raised there. So, I went to his camp and everything. So, it is kind of like a mentor at the time. We just always talked, always laughed, always joked, and then we always just kept in touch as my career went on. But now, he is my brother. To be an NBA player alongside him on the same team is just amazing.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on comparisons to Dwyane Wade
quotes.excerpt: I try not to be a duplicate of who he is, but he is a legend.
quotes.quote: To be honest, I do not really feel the pressure. Obviously, I just take parts of their games and add it to mine. I try not to be a duplicate of who he is, but he is a legend, Hall of Famer, and this is who I grew up watching. My mom was a Heat fan, so I grew up watching Wade and LeBron on the Heat at the time. So, that is why I kind of play similar because that is all I know at the time.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on high expectations for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: At the end of the day, we are just going out there to play basketball.
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, we are just going out there to play basketball. With the team we got, we are going to perform. The whole world got high expectations of us, but we are just going to go there and compete, have fun. We are teammates for a whole year, two years, so I am here for it.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on his top three jersey swaps
quotes.excerpt: I got LeBron, I got Anthony Edwards, and then I got Buddy Hield.
quotes.quote: I got LeBron, I got Anthony Edwards, and then I got Buddy Hield.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on how the NBA game has changed
quotes.excerpt: The game is changing, obviously the game changed a little bit with the shooting and everything like that.
quotes.quote: The game is changing, obviously the game changed a little bit with the shooting and everything like that. I know who they are, and obviously they are legends, legends to the game, and I have nothing but respect for them.

quotes.speaker: V.J. Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: V.J. Edgecombe on the most impressive championship run
quotes.excerpt: A 3-1 comeback obviously, that is number one. I don't care what nobody says.
quotes.quote: A 3-1 comeback obviously, that is number one. I do not care what nobody says, that has got to be number one. I was a fan of Steph's 2022 year with the Golden State Warriors. I was a fan of that one, so I say those two.
